objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed paperlessly from creation and editing to release, distribution and archiving.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation of the document.

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Consecutive number assigned to the document.

attributes.name: reference
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_application
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: relevant_company
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: area_of_validity
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: Attribute for assigning authorizations for readers via User Group assignment.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Attribute for assigning personal authorizations and the registered author.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Attribute for assigning additional personal change rights.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Attribute for assigning personal authorizations and reviewers.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Attribute for assigning personal authorizations and releasers.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Document status.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Document version.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document by TAG technology.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which validity is counted.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period for extended validity.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date resulting from Valid From and Period Of Extended Validity.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration for which archived documents are retained.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Type selected when creating a new document and used for defining templates, validity period and archive duration.

attributes.name: type_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation for a document type.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selectable when creating new objects.

objs.name: object_cover
objs.description: Pure object cover to which external files or documents can be uploaded.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: File uploaded to an object cover.

objs.name: office_format
objs.description: Standard MS Office format used to generate new documents.

objs.name: pdf
objs.description: Converted format displayed on the web after a document is saved.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: Document type used for company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Document type describing locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Document type describing specific procedures, process sequences, details and responsible persons.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Document type used to document detailed work steps relevant for few departments.

objs.name: form
objs.description: Supplement to a work instruction.

objs.name: checklist
objs.description: Supplement to a work instruction.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Object that documents can be linked with and for which documents can be filed process-specifically.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Object that documents can be automatically linked with.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Object that documents can be automatically linked with.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Object that documents can be linked to.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: Master data example and attribute for linking documents.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Object type that can supplement a document and is not subject to the release cycle of the main document.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attached to a main document and automatically released with the release of the main document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Attachment status.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Attachment version.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Validity date shared with the main document when validity is extended.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal for a document that can be created and managed without affecting content or version history.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status of the Change proposal.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group used for assigning authorizations, readers, roles, distribution and archive access.

objs.name: person
objs.description: User or person assigned to authorizations, roles, distribution or workflow tasks.

objs.name: authorization
objs.description: Read and change rights assigned at user group or person level.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: Workflow-supported process for approval, validity extension, override, reactivation, acknowledgement or translation.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task in a workflow processed by workflow participants.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature used by workflow participants to complete tasks and documented for each released version.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List of User Groups and persons assigned to distribution for a document.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation of acknowledgement requested from persons and users of assigned User Groups.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: Request created before validity expires and linked to the document to be checked.

objs.name: request_for_aks
objs.description: Request created to invalidate a selected document.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to re-validate invalidated documents.

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: Specific User Group retaining read access to archived documents.

objs.name: business_admin_group
objs.description: Group permitted to create requests for reactivation.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system where document visibility can be specified.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Language-dependent version of released document content.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: User and role-specific dashboard filled using distribution groups.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Evaluation report available for documents in the system.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document is created in the system by attachment of a new information object and selection of the corresponding document type.

evts.name: select_document_template
evts.description: A document template is selected when creating new objects.

evts.name: create_object_cover
evts.description: A pure object cover is created.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: External files or documents are uploaded to an object cover.

evts.name: generate_document
evts.description: New documents are generated based on standard MS Office formats.

evts.name: maintain_document_property
evts.description: Standardized and customer-specific metadata is maintained in document properties.

evts.name: edit_content
evts.description: Document content is edited with an implemented editing client.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: A document is saved.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: A saved document is automatically and system-supported converted to PDF.

evts.name: display_pdf
evts.description: The current converted version is displayed on the web as PDF.

evts.name: change_released_document
evts.description: Changes to released documents result in creation of a new editing version.

evts.name: create_editing_version
evts.description: A new editing version is created for a valid and released document or after scheduling a Change proposal.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Group and person-related authorizations are assigned in document properties.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is added to a document.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: An Attachment is added to a document.

evts.name: release_additional_information
evts.description: Additional information is released directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: publish_additional_information
evts.description: Additional information is published directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_information
evts.description: Additional information can be deleted again directly.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Modification of Attachments triggers a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Attachments are marked for archiving and archived with the release of the next version of the main document.

evts.name: start_approval_process
evts.description: The approval process is initiated after document creation, attribute and content maintenance and definition of document control.

evts.name: sign_creation
evts.description: The registered author signs the creation of the document in the Creator workflow step.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Assigned reviewers check the document content according to technical and formal aspects.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser releases the document after review.

evts.name: reject_review
evts.description: A rejection during review cancels the workflow for all subsequent participants.

evts.name: reject_release
evts.description: A rejection during release cancels the workflow for all subsequent participants.

evts.name: send_email_notification
evts.description: The system informs involved users of workflow task status or document-related events by e-mail notifications.

evts.name: document_signature
evts.description: Workflow participants complete tasks with an electronic signature.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: A valid and released document is revised.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: An employee with author rights creates a Change proposal for a document.

evts.name: display_change_proposal
evts.description: A Change proposal is displayed in the document.

evts.name: inform_author
evts.description: The author of the underlying document is informed by e-mail when a Change proposal is created.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal_for_implementation
evts.description: A Change proposal is scheduled for implementation.

evts.name: document_change_proposal_editing
evts.description: The author documents editing of assigned Change proposals directly in the Change proposal.

evts.name: notify_proposal_creator
evts.description: The Creator of the proposal receives an e-mail notification after editing is documented.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Completed Change proposals are no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: A request for validity extension is created by the system 30 days before the Valid Until date.

evts.name: check_extended_validity
evts.description: Users check whether the document remains valid, needs revision, or must be invalidated.

evts.name: declare_additional_validity
evts.description: Additional validity is declared for the document.

evts.name: delete_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The request for validity extension is deleted when additional validity is declared or a revised version is released.

evts.name: update_valid_until
evts.description: The Valid Until date is updated by the default value of 3 years.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension_process
evts.description: The validity extension process is automatically terminated when a new revised version is released or when suspension is declared.

evts.name: create_request_for_aks
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request for AKS for a selected document.

evts.name: start_aks_workflow
evts.description: The workflow for processing the request for AKS is started automatically.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: The last valid and approved version of the document is given the status Out of force.

evts.name: delete_edited_version
evts.description: Existing edited versions are deleted after declaration of Out of force.

evts.name: revoke_authorization
evts.description: All rights except for the archive group are revoked.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Documents are physically deleted after the archive period has expired.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: A request for reactivation is created in the folder provided and the document is selected for reactivation.

evts.name: start_reactivation_workflow
evts.description: The workflow for reactivation is started automatically.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: The Creator of the request confirms the reactivation.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: A new version of the document is created and metadata, properties and authorizations are retained or set.

evts.name: reactivate_attachment
evts.description: Attachments archived with the document are reactivated.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: User Groups and persons are assigned to the Distribution list for a document.

evts.name: send_distribution_email
evts.description: Assigned users and users of assigned User Groups are informed by e-mail notification when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Persons and users of assigned User Groups are requested by e-mail to actively confirm acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient confirms acknowledgement through a workflow-supported task without a signature.

evts.name: notify_author_team
evts.description: The author team receives an overview of unconfirmed acknowledgements and notification when all acknowledgements are confirmed.

evts.name: fill_dashboard
evts.description: User and role-specific dashboards are filled by defining distribution groups in the distribution list per document.

evts.name: evaluate_report
evts.description: A report evaluates documents, instructions or acknowledgements depending on selected parameters.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: A translator translates released content into another language.

evts.name: check_translation
evts.description: The translated version is checked with workflow support.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The translated language version is released with workflow support.

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: For each document in a multi-client system, visibility in clients is specified.

evts.name: create_local_document
evts.description: A new document is created in a client for a local addition to a document.

evts.name: create_reference
evts.description: A reference to the original document is created for the extended local document.
